front: Identity-preserving edit for this production 2D game, keeping the same adult Chinese swordsman, stern face, short beard, dark topknot, warm ochre ink-and-gouache palette, plain opaque brown boxer briefs, empty hands and bare feet. Art direction: he is a lean ordinary thirty-something traveler with a naturally smooth relaxed torso and modest shoulders. Visibly simplify the original anatomy. Paint a continuous softly rounded abdomen, only a discreet navel and a single broad faint flank shadow; erase all individual six-pack blocks, serratus stripes, veins and tendon hatching. Flatten the puffed-out pectorals and rounded deltoid bulbs. Arms and thighs are slim smooth tapered forms, about one third the previous internal ink strokes. Keep clear economical brown contour ink and restrained warm flat wash with one soft shadow plane per limb. No blurring, no beauty filters, no glossy definition. Preserve the precise current facial expression, pose, empty hand shapes, waistband, limb lengths, foot placement, source canvas aspect ratio and registration. Sharp alpha silhouettes, genuinely transparent backdrop all across the canvas. No cast shadow, text, labels or halo. Image 1 is the edit target. Output one centered full-height straight-on front standing figure exactly in the same position in the portrait canvas. The eyes, chin, wrist, waistband, knees and feet stay at their current heights.
